review_scope: Independent mathematical and exact-source review of all HLP1-HLP32. The finite Hecke algebraic, literal lattice/action and entire conditional nonempty_spec constructions are checked. Original complex, arithmetic and common-reading producer hypotheses are not counted as consequences.

claim_results.checks: The literal ambient GenAt/GenAt0 range is 1<=k<=nV, distinct from LTD6 row k<=r. The actual OLat finite generator set, complex span and jMt-basis/sub fields give precisely S and L0.

Both uniformizers differ by an integral diagonal unit with integral inverse. Equal conjugate places give equal underlying real place; the now-written localization and density argument proves equality of the actual embedding field, hence equality of the whole SplitPlace record.

Injectivity of the prescribed realization and MtInput.rat define one L-linear operator before all split-place/uniformizer witnesses. The empty-witness branch is vacuous, and HeckeStdPlain linearity is used on its actual TypeSp and bad set.

The original split-place existence hypothesis supplies witnesses for both eligible generators. Complex commutation descends through the same injective realization. Ineligible zero branches and the literal tensor base change match hLC/hKC at every index.

The jMt basis identifies the finite complexification and preserves characteristic polynomials under the actual embeddings. A nonzero generalized vector gives a genuine eigenvector by its least annihilating exponent; the zero-dimensional case is included.

One product of finitely many prime-to-ell denominators works for all roots with multiplicity. The monic scaled polynomial has integral coefficients after both embeddings; valuation integrally closedness and the original Z_ell-unit inverse yield the exact O-integrality assertion.

Every relevant complex root is realized on the actual type space, and the split conjugate place is away from ell. HLP6 gives the second HeckeStd0 conjunct and HLP4 gives commutation. SplitK is retained separately or supplied by the exact MR23 finite-extension argument.

The original MtInput.int coefficient combination lifts uniquely through jMt on the same finite generator set. ec_w makes its coefficients O-valued. This proves complete HeckeIntTw at twisted places and preservation of the original L0.

LTD3 applies to the possibly infinite commuting split integral family. The evaluation kernel is exactly the nilradical. Its reduced image is a finite O-submodule of O^s; the finite injective extension to O^s and localized determinant argument exhaust every maximal ideal by supported residual characters. No finiteness of the original Hecke algebra is assumed.

LocT retains the actual (j,w,maximal ideal) triple with eligibility and twisted guards. Finiteness, maximal-ideal exhaustion and XOf nonemptiness follow from HLP9; equality of generator values forces equality of characters on the generated algebra.

The finite preimage S spans U by extending a vanishing functional and using the actual complex generator span. Tensoring then proves the full K-span of iV(S), not an arbitrary full-rank replacement lattice.

The actual NCov.part/off direct sum defines the source projection. Its O-span of the projected prescribed generators is finite and torsion free; clearing denominators and coordinate induction over the DVR prove freeness, including dimension zero.

The canonical tensor map is surjective by the full generator span and injective by clearing a common denominator. It has the same inclusion-localization property as MtLoc, hence identifies the literal mtEquiv.

The specified PsiC and prMtC are obtained from that canonical localization and the same projection. Their range and injectivity are exact; Psi(pr(u))-iV(u) lies in the original off-part, and the integral pure-tensor identity is retained.

Applying the canonical tensor inclusion to the finite O-combinations gives exactly the prMt_lat span equality. The K-span of the full rational projection range is the full tensor module. Both original clauses use the original domain and generator set.

The retained complex no-Jordan assertion transfers to the complexification. Minimal-polynomial degree is preserved by injective base change, so the characteristic-zero minimal polynomial is separable; its actual coefficient-field image gives semisimplicity. No invariant Hermitian/Petersson producer is silently supplied.

On each simultaneous generalized block, every semisimple generator acts as the prescribed character. Projection along the original blocks commutes with the whole algebra. Integral stability of L0 then gives an actual action on N=p(L0).

Evaluation has image exactly the original generated function algebra TOf. Its kernel kills the actual part under semisimplicity, hence kills MtSub. The resulting descended action has the literal generator equation in the original V.

An element acting trivially on MtSub kills its K-span, hence every nonzero supported character space. Evaluation is zero at every original point, proving faithfulness and all ActSpec/ActEx fields on the same module.

Every source-selected actC witness already satisfies the literal ActSpec equation. Evaluation on pure tensors and addition yield full ActHK for that selected action and exact subsequent NdSpec.act_hK transport.

Equal residual kernels give congruent point values by the fixed scalar maps, and HLP10 gives finite nonempty points. MR24 and MR25 apply with all hypotheses; the actual MtLoc/Psi/ActHK transports the common eigenvector to the specified localization.

Generic OsInt now uses only the specified ring map OtoLL and integrality of its images. Injectivity is required only later under OsConcrete. Bj uses the distinct original MjLat(j).gen relation module; saturated relations and the inherited split-projective argument give freeness through the actual sOfC map.

A finite Q-basis and the prescribed finite big(w) values generate one finite subextension of the fixed Qbar_ell. The actual fraction-field identification supplies iq with the required scalar, complex and finite-value equations for every compatible larger extension.

The retained PsiInt gives a unique integral-unit lift under the actual injective O-to-K map. Character comparison gives equality of the prescribed kernels. The optional monic finite-order argument now explicitly requires N>0, as does every actual ell-power application.

The original Artin target, open kernel and anticyclotomic identity transfer through the exact kernel comparison. Nontrivial inertia and above-ell decomposition triviality remain explicitly supplied arithmetic inputs; the unramified transported base twist preserves the exhibited ramification at Q.

Distinct rational type primes and the original within-family injection make selected labels unique. The original stored tg is preserved at those primes; LS19 supplies all remaining valuations, with the exact inertia/density TameGenAt assertion.

Every LocNd/mkX field matches its literal source object. In particular the finite free MtSub, actual actC, projection spans, nonzero point eigenspaces, character for every c with integer exponent, original bad sets and the corrected factorization exponents s0 are preserved. Arithmetic/continuity antecedents are retained.

mkT uses the same mkX and C.twI/C.sd, actual twist map and psi. All order, kernel, AntiHom, RamExactly and every-valuation local-triviality guards are retained. TwAlgAt and the stronger full-field common-overfield TwRdAt remain distinct hypotheses.

Fixed-index trO/trK/trPsi/trX are identity transports after the actual equalities of j,w. The maximal ideal, off-part projection error, character labels and generator action are all unchanged, matching every corresponding NonemptySpec field.

Every candidate coefficient map in bj_rel equals sOfC by the injected fraction-field square, so the exact relation-span iff holds universally. psi_eq follows through the original C.embW and given psi0 comparison for every candidate y; no character or embedding is replaced.

The complete generic nonempty_spec input list and every NdSpec field were matched to source. The corrected Qc_eq uses the retained B0.Qw=C.Q hypothesis; only index transports and twist/side choices are reflexive. All bridge norm/GoodCoef/iq and common-reading witnesses remain the supplied original ones.

The one fixed-algebraic-closure compositum contains F1(j,w), F2(w), F3(w), F4(w), each before all later compatible extensions. F3/F4 uniform suppliers remain explicit, and the construction does not claim unconditional ndSpec_exists, AutSpec, NBuilt or the final theorem.
